authors.bio: Al Kovalick has worked in the field of hybrid AV/IT systems for the past 20 years. Previously, he was a digital systems designer and technical strategist for Hewlett-Packard. Following HP, from 1999 to 2004, he was the CTO of Pinnacle Systems. For the next six years he was a Corporate Fellow at Avid. In 2011, Kovalick founded Media Systems Consulting. — Kovalick is an active speaker, educator, author and participant with industry bodies including SMPTE and AMWA. He has presented more than 50 papers at industry conferences worldwide and holds 18 US and foreign patents. He is the author of the book “Video Systems in an IT Environment, 2ed.” In 2009 Kovalick was awarded the David Sarnoff Gold Medal from SMPTE. Kovalick has a BSEE degree from San Jose State University and a MSEE degree from the University of California at Berkeley. He is a SMPTE Fellow. Kovalick can be contacted at www.theAVITbook.com.
